fields.label: Event write-up
fields.sample:
For a whole year, we worked together, learned together and grew together. Tonight we’re gathered to applaud the colleagues whose hard work made a difference.
Nominees were chosen by the votes of all employees; the winners will be announced on stage. Take your seat: the curtain is rising.

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.sample: Thank you all for the hard work, solidarity and creativity you showed this year. The awards went to a few, but the success belongs to all of us. Here’s to many more award-winning years!

elements.name: Haber metni
elements.text:
The team that has worked, learned and grown to­geth­er all year gath­ers this evening to ap­plaud the col­leagues whose ded­i­ca­tion made a dif­fer­ence. Nom­i­nees were chosen in a vote open to every em­ploy­ee in the com­pa­ny; the re­sults are kept in sealed en­velopes, in the pres­ence of a notary.
At the cer­e­mo­ny, where eigh­teen nom­i­nees will com­pete in six cat­e­gories, the win­ners will be an­nounced on stage one by one. The or­ga­niz­ing com­mit­tee said the hall has been fully ren­o­vat­ed, from the red carpet to the stage, and that the night’s sur­prise will be kept under wraps until the very last moment.
The hottest topic back­stage is who will take home the “Our Spirit” award. With the prize de­cid­ed by a vote of all em­ploy­ees, the number of people plac­ing their guess­es grows by the day. The com­mit­tee of­fered just one clue: the winner will be the person most sur­prised to re­ceive it.
The chef’s four-course menu will be served at the gala dinner; the night opens with live jazz and con­tin­ues on the dance floor after the awards. Guests are asked to pose for the of­fi­cial pho­tog­ra­pher on the red carpet and to show their in­vi­ta­tion stub at the en­trance. The full list of nom­i­nees, the jury and voting de­tails are on page two.

elements.name: Oylama metni
elements.text:
Nom­i­nees were chosen by all em­ploy­ees through an online vote that stayed open through­out No­vem­ber. Each em­ploy­ee cast one vote per cat­e­go­ry; voting for your own team was al­lowed, voting for your­self was not. The votes were count­ed by an in­de­pen­dent au­di­tor, and the re­sults were placed in sealed en­velopes that not even the jury mem­bers have seen. For the Our Spirit award, even the list of nom­i­nees was kept secret; the en­ve­lope will be opened only on stage, by the host of the evening. In case of a tie, the award will be shared and both win­ners called to the stage together.
After the vote, the jury re­viewed each nominee’s year of work in every cat­e­go­ry, but left the em­ploy­ees’ votes un­touched. Jury mem­bers did not weigh in on cat­e­gories with nom­i­nees from their own teams. Along­side their stat­uettes, win­ners will re­ceive a day off and the finest prize of the year: a stand­ing ova­tion from the whole hall. A sug­ges­tion box for next year’s vote will stay open in the foyer all night.

elements.name: Kulis
elements.text:
◆ We’ve learned that the host rewrote the speech three times; the final version is hidden backstage.
◆ Rumor has it the statuettes were polished the day before, and one still bears a fingerprint.
◆ One of the rookie nominees rehearsed an acceptance speech in front of the mirror twenty times.
◆ The kitchen team prepared two thousand gold-leaf chocolates for the midnight treats.
◆ Word is the winners will choose the jazz quartet’s walk-on song.
◆ We’ve learned the red carpet was extended by two meters at the last minute to look better in photos.
◆ The color of the general manager’s tie is the night’s best-kept secret. Hint: it’s not gold.
◆ The Our Spirit award envelope will travel all night in the host’s inside pocket.
